title: Verify global search returns empty results for Time Clock user
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Time Clock role.
Customers and work orders exist in the system that would normally match the search.
Context: a build change makes the Time Clock role return empty search data (FetchData controller).
steps:
1. Click the top search bar.
2. Type the name of an existing customer and press Enter.
3. Type an existing work order number and press Enter.
expected: Global search returns EMPTY results for both searches - no customers, work orders, or other records are returned to the Time Clock user.
